tasks.short: Meet health, sanitation and embalming requirements

steps.what: Check current health and sanitation requirements and case permissions
Verify case identity, permissions and suitability of planned work
Follow sanitation procedures and monitor compliance during embalming
Record requirement checks and observed compliance issues

tasks.design: Configure dated procedure links and a case-check record in {DOCS}. The embalmer verifies permissions and carries out sanitation work personally; writing the existing compliance record is a separate step and does not certify compliance automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure versions and case-check headings require repeated handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference links and record fields can reduce a small amount of clerical work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising case-specific hazards and following appropriate physical practices.
tasks.human_edge: Professional responsibility for identity, permissions and safe conduct.
tasks.altitude: Make the supporting record easier to trace while retaining physical compliance work.

reach.learn: Distinguish a completed checklist from observed safe work

evidence.claim: Native procedure links and case-record fields may reduce clerical handling; the digest provides no embalming compliance capability or measured time case.

assumptions: Baseline includes existing checks and their case record; no new approval stage or invented statutory form is added.

The embalmer captures case identifier, procedure version and permission status in s1-s2, then observed checks, date and any unresolved issue in s4. Reading, capture and correction are priced. Missing permission or uncertain rules require manual resolution, not a green status inferred by software.
Use native linked references and fields first; no model chooses clinical or technical procedures.
Author saves in the same case document have fully retained negligible time and no gate.
unknowns: Existing procedure versioning and record layout
research_questions: Do native links reduce repeat lookup without hiding an outdated or inapplicable requirement?

incremental.description: Maintain authorised procedure references and fields

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R95 gross5 less1 upkeep gives central4. Low retains all15 lookup and9/10 recording when every case requires fresh source reading: gross1 less1=0. High retains13/15 lookup and9/10 recording when procedure links are current and the record already matches the work: gross3 less1=2. Identity, permission judgement and physical compliance remain full.

tasks.short: Coordinate funeral activities as funeral director

steps.what: Retrieve funeral case preferences and supplier details
Clarify family priorities and resolve funeral arrangements
Write funeral schedule and coordination plan
Enter requested funeral services and reservation details
Send service requests and confirm arrangements with suppliers
Assign funeral crew responsibilities and record changes
Communicate final funeral crew assignments and schedule
Oversee funeral activities and resolve live coordination problems

tasks.design: Configure a single funeral plan and reusable service-request fields in {DOCS}, linked to {CALENDAR}. Family discussion, supplier requests, crew assignment, crew communication and live coordination each retain their own work and authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case details are repeatedly located and written into schedules and service requests.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document fields and calendar links can reuse verified details.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing family wishes, supplier constraints and unforeseen events with dignity.
tasks.human_edge: Sensitive judgement and dependable coordination under pressure.
tasks.altitude: Reduce schedule assembly while protecting personal service.

evidence.claim: A linked funeral case file and native schedule templates could reduce repeated entry; this is not demonstrated by the digest's death-notice products.

assumptions: This allocation includes director coordination and its actual records and handoffs. The initial detailed family interview is separately owned by task4496, and physical casket and procession assistance by4505; do not charge the same episode twice.

The director captures verified case identity, preferences, dates, locations and supplier contacts in s1-s3; s4 records actual availability and service requests; s5 produces confirmations and s6 records crew assignments and changes. All capture remains counted, with manual entry and direct confirmation when fields or availability are missing.
Native document and calendar templates come first; there is no automatic supplier booking, assignment decision or unlisted machine send.
Same-system author saves are retained within the record steps, with no self-approval stage.
unknowns: Overlap between embalmer and director duties
research_questions: Can linked case fields reduce plan and request entry without carrying forward an obsolete time or location?

already_counted.description: Check coordination plan and service request fields

incremental.description: Maintain plan fields and supplier directory links

approvals.approved_version: Exact supplier request, service, date, location, price where applicable and destination checked before each send; changes void check
Exact crew assignments and current funeral schedule being communicated; changes require an updated briefing

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R91 gross9 less2 upkeep gives central7. Low retains all10 lookup,19/20 plan writing and9/10 request entry with varied suppliers and unsuitable templates: gross2 less2=0. High retains9/10 lookup,17/20 plan writing and8/10 request entry with compatible fields and stable confirmations: gross6 less2=4. Family decisions, real sends, crew assignment, briefing and live coordination stay full.

tasks.short: Interview families about notices, caskets and funeral arrangements

steps.what: Conduct interviews about obituary facts, preferences and funeral choices
Look up casket, urn and obituary preparation options
Check available burial or cremation locations and times
Write interview facts, selections and proposed arrangements
Confirm recorded selections and proposed arrangements with family

tasks.design: Configure current catalogue links and an interview record in {DOCS}, with availability references from {CALENDAR}. The family conversation remains personal; recording facts and choices is priced separately, and final confirmation uses the checked version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preferences, obituary facts and arrangements are repeatedly entered and checked across references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms and linked current references can reduce clerical repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Helping a grieving family make choices at its own pace and checking uncertain facts sensitively.
tasks.human_edge: Empathy and respect for the family's wishes.
tasks.altitude: Keep interviews personal while reducing repeated record entry.

reach.learn: Reuse confirmed facts without treating interview notes as permission to publish

evidence.claim: The digest describes Rouwadvertentiemaken.nl notice preparation and placement with newspaper requirement checks; this supports a structured notice-information handoff, not interview automation.
Interview record and catalogue-lookup savings remain an unmeasured E1 design.

assumptions: Task includes the interview, its actual record and confirmation. Writing or publishing the notice, ordering a casket and final venue booking require separate actions in the funeral workflow and are not silently performed here.

The arranger obtains names, dates, family preferences and provisional choices in s1; captures current item identifier and catalogue terms in s2 and venue, time, source and checked-at time in s3; writes these and unresolved questions in s4. Capture is retained; missing facts or stale availability are confirmed manually before any later booking.
Native forms and catalogue links come first; no invented biography, automatic selection or unlisted publication.
Same-system author saves in s4 remain fully retained without an approval stage.
unknowns: Existing interview form and catalogue integration
How the family confirms factual corrections
research_questions: Do structured interview notes reduce re-entry while preserving uncertain facts and provisional choices?

incremental.description: Maintain catalogue links and arrangement fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact names, dates, selected items and proposed location and time communicated to the family; edits require renewed checking and are not publication approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R89 gross11 less2 upkeep gives central9. Low retains15/15 catalogue lookup,9/10 availability lookup and19/20 record writing when references are stale and choices uncertain: gross2 less2=0. High retains13/15 catalogue,9/10 availability and16/20 recording when current identifiers and reusable fields fit: gross7 less2=5. Interview and family confirmation remain full.

tasks.short: Place caskets in hearses and organise cemetery processions

steps.what: Check casket, hearse access and procession conditions
Assist with placing caskets in hearses
Organize cemetery procession order and immediate crew positions
outputs: chosen procession order and crew positions

steps.what: Communicate procession order and direct crew movement
inputs: chosen procession order and crew positions

tasks.design: Retain physical casket assistance and live procession organisation as human work. The current funeral plan in {DOCS} can be viewed before the activity, but native templates do not replace handling, situational choices or direct crew communication.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on physical presence and the actual conditions at the hearse and cemetery.
tasks.enabler_now: A native plan view can supply context but offers no demonstrated reduction in this hands-on episode.
tasks.still_hard: Safe coordinated movement with dignity under changing site conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Physical care and responsive direction of the crew.
tasks.altitude: No supported software saving in the physical execution.

evidence.claim: The digest's notice-preparation tools do not perform physical casket handling or live procession direction; no software saving is supported for this episode.

assumptions: Includes immediate condition checks, handling, procession decisions and crew communication. Funeral plan writing and crew assignment records are explicitly priced in task4494; if a separate execution log is actually written here, measure it before revising this zero.

The funeral director produces the current plan in task4494 s3 and assignment record in s6, with their capture time counted there; the embalmer observes physical conditions in s1. No sold-out flag, structured readiness code or inferred safe state is assumed.
A native plan view or template does not remove the necessary physical checks or actions. No extra till setting, hidden lookup, record write or machine action is claimed.
No new software or upkeep is introduced, so incremental effort is zero.
unknowns: Whether the actual site uses a separate execution log
Exact division of handling and procession direction
research_questions: Is there any separate clerical action in this execution episode beyond the plan already priced in coordination?

already_counted.description: All hands-on checks, handling, decisions and direction

incremental.description: No new software or maintenance introduced

approvals.approved_version: Current procession order, crew positions and immediate movement instruction checked against live conditions before each direction; changed conditions require a new check
